A weekly record of my progress through the course. Each entry follows the same structure: the session or topic covered, what I did, what I learned, difficulties or open questions, and what to do next. Entries link to the relevant projects and tutorials. My use of AI tools is recorded separately in the [AI use log](../ai-use-log.qmd).
